Ganymede equals the giant moon. Bigger than Mercury does not make Ganymede a planet: it orbits Jupiter, so it is a moon.

clips.send: GALILEAN MOONS Four big moons Galileo found them in January 1610 with a small telescope. Seeing moons circle another planet showed that not everything orbits Earth. Io, Europa and Ganymede tug on each other in a 1 : 2 : 4 rhythm (an orbital resonance). Those regular tugs keep their orbits slightly oval, so Jupiter’s tides flex them and heat their insides: volcanoes on Io, an ocean under Europa’s ice. You can see all four with ordinary binoculars as tiny dots next to Jupiter. MEMORY HINT Order outward: “I Eat Green Cheese” equals Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto. Common mix-up:A resonance does not mean the moons line up all together: in fact Io, Europa and Ganymede can never all be on the same side of Jupiter at once.

The air is so thin that liquid water quickly boils away or freezes, but ice fills its polar caps and lies under the ground. Since 2021 the Perseverance rover has been collecting rock samples in Jezero Crater, an ancient lake bed. A Mars day (a “sol”) is 24 h 40 min, almost like ours. Mars is red because of rust (iron oxide) in its dust, not because it is hot.

clips.send: 木卫一（伊奥）。木星的卫星。已知火山活动最剧烈的世界：有 400 多座活火山。木星的潮汐力在木卫一公转时不断挤压、拉伸它；与木卫二、木卫三的共振让它的轨道一直略呈椭圆，挤压从不停止，于是内部被加热。硫和二氧化硫霜把它染成了黄、橙、红和白色。木卫一：最靠内的大卫星，火山的世界。木卫一的热量不是来自太阳，而是来自木星潮汐的挤压。

伽利略卫星 四颗大卫星 伽利略在 1610 年 1 月用一架小望远镜发现了它们。看到卫星绕着另一颗行星转，说明并不是所有天体都绕地球转。 木卫一、木卫二和木卫三以 1 : 2 : 4 的节奏互相拉扯（轨道共振）。 这种规律的拉扯让轨道保持略呈椭圆，于是木星的潮汐反复弯曲它们、加热内部：木卫一有火山，木卫二的冰下有海洋。 用普通的双筒望远镜就能看到它们：木星旁边的四个小亮点。 记忆小窍门 由内向外：木卫一、二、三、四，正好按编号排列。 容易混淆：共振并不意味着三颗卫星会排成一线：事实上，木卫一、木卫二和木卫三永远不可能同时出现在木星的同一侧。
